classification.difficultyReason: Select right triangles within composite diagrams, transfer and combine horizontal or vertical lengths, and order successive Pythagorean calculations when one unknown supplies a later leg.

content.prompt: Find the values of $x$, $y$ and $z$ in these diagrams.

spec.description: Rectangle with diagonal from bottom-left to top-right; right-angle marks at top-left and bottom-right. Ordinary source blue outlines use house black.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements and unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Two right triangles sharing the vertical altitude 12; base segments 5 and 9. Ordinary outlines are black.
spec.mathematics: Left hypotenuse x and right hypotenuse y.

spec.description: Triangle above a rectangular strip. The dimension 24 ends at the dashed horizontal, excluding the strip height 4. Both source right-angle marks and the redundant measurement 4 are retained.
spec.mathematics: Upper right triangle has legs 24 and 10 and hypotenuse x.
spec.answerVisibility: The upper horizontal length is inferred from the rectangle, not printed.

answer.worked:
The dashed horizontal has length $10$, equal to the bottom side of the rectangle.
$\begin{aligned}x^2&=24^2+10^2\\x^2&=576+100\\x^2&=676\\x&=26\end{aligned}$

spec.description: Nested right triangles with common vertical side 24 and consecutive base segments 8 and 10.
spec.mathematics: Outer base is 18; x is the outer hypotenuse and y the inner hypotenuse.
spec.answerVisibility: The total base and calculated hypotenuses are not supplied.

spec.description: Principal segments in black with the source red dashed perpendicular scaffold retained in standard red. No editorial vertex letters print. The bottom auxiliary horizontal is 10, the right portion of the middle horizontal is 10, the upper height is 15 and the lower drop is 9.
spec.mathematics: For x the legs are 15 and 20; for y they are 24 and 10.
spec.answerVisibility: Derived lengths 20 and 24 and all answers remain hidden.

answer.short:
$x=25$, $y=26$

Use horizontal length $10+10=20$ for $x$ and vertical length $15+9=24$ for $y$.
answer.worked:
For $x$, the horizontal length is $10+10=20$.
$\begin{aligned}x^2&=15^2+20^2\\x^2&=225+400\\x^2&=625\\x&=25\end{aligned}$
For $y$, the vertical length is $15+9=24$ and the horizontal length is $10$.
$\begin{aligned}y^2&=24^2+10^2\\y^2&=576+100\\y^2&=676\\y&=26\end{aligned}$

spec.description: Chain of three right triangles, preserving the straight upper sloping edge, internal segments and all three right-angle marks. No editorial vertex letters print.
spec.mathematics: The triangle with legs 12 and 9 has hypotenuse x; the triangle with legs x and 20 has hypotenuse y; the triangle with legs 16 and 12 has hypotenuse z.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 16, 12, 9, 20 and the unknown labels are visible.

answer.short:
$x=15$, $y=25$, $z=20$

Find $x$ from the legs $12$ and $9$, then use it to find $y$.
